text:
DeployBot: INIT phased rollout v1.14.2 wave=region-staggered -> start 1733331234
alice.m: quick status check before we kick off - APAC headroom?
ben.k: APAC: 18 spare GPUs after warmup, avg lat 48ms, p95 115ms
carol_sre: EU looks tight. only ~6 spare GPUs, p99 rising for small models, seeing queue growth
samir_infra: US warm pool healthy (30), can take +10% traffic if we go sequential
alice.m: plan: start US 8% -> observe 10m -> then EU if ok, else pin EU and investigate -> APAC limited probe 4% while EU triages
deploybot: starting region=US slice=8% canary=on -> url: https://deploy.internal/canary/1733331234
grace.p: kicking off smoke (chat + embeddings) on US canary now
grace.p: smoke pass for US: chat OK, embeddings median 1.1s, errors 0
sre_oncall: watching metrics, alert hooks set (cpu>85% 3m, queue>50 2m)
ben.k: noted, alerts will post to #eng-oncall and pager if threshold held
alice.m: hold EU until SRE confirms US stability
carol_sre: confirmed US stable. EU scheduled in 8m but I want a probe first
samir_infra: APAC kv-cache prefetch started, priming top prefixes
deploybot: scheduling EU probe in 5m -> probe slice=4%
grace.p: EU probe running with longer contexts to simulate worst-case
grace.p: EU probe step 3 produced p95 spike to ~285ms
sre_oncall: saw EU p95 spike and p99 bump; investigating backend queueing. rolling EU back to previous version now
deploybot: EU rollback -> slice=0% trace=0x7a2f -> actioned 1733331460
carol_sre: recommend pin EU to v1.14.1 until root cause identified (suggest 30-60m)
alice.m: agree. pin EU and notify CS/PM for release note update
ben.k: drafting release note blurb: "EU: v1.14.2 rollout paused; traffic pinned to v1.14.1 due to latency regression under load."
samir_infra: APAC probe? EU pinned -> suggest minimal APAC probe 4% to validate behavior there, hold off full APAC until EU cleared
alice.m: ok small APAC probe only. monitor 10m window
deploybot: APAC probe start slice=4% -> probe url https://deploy.internal/probe/1733331234
grace.p: APAC probe 3m in: chat OK, embeddings median 1.2s, no errors so far
sre_oncall: APAC metrics: p95 140ms, p99 210ms -> within probe thresholds
carol_sre: pin recorded: EU pinned_version=1.14.1 locked_until=1733335200 (approx 1h)
ben.k: updated rollout note: "US: 8% live; EU: pinned to 1.14.1; APAC: 4% probe ongoing. Investigating EU latency regression."
alice.m: next steps: SRE to root cause EU regression, infra to collect perf traces and kernel/quantization diffs, PM to update release notes and coordinate customer comms
samir_infra: gathering perf dumps + tracer logs now, ETA ~25m. will attach to ticket
carol_sre: opening incident ticket to track RCA (if unresolved in 1h we'll start postmortem), tagging runtime & perf teams
deploybot: wave paused for EU; US/APAC status persisted to deploy dashboard -> https://ops.internal/deploys/1733331234
alice.m: if APAC stays clean after 10m we'll consider bumping APAC to 8% and re-evaluating EU after fixes. keep communications here
ben.k: thanks all — please paste any anomalous logs here. :thumbsup:
sre_oncall: will escalate to eng-runtime on new p95/p99 spikes.
